payload.summary: From Jim (2026-07-29, log only — no action now): dispatched agents can run under super-restrictive sandboxes that break the work in confusing ways. Observed on speed-count-game: cursor sandbox permission issues during a codex-driven nahel flow; also codex sandbox consistently fails nahels own pgid test (ps blocked). Jims background note: unattended nahel dispatch with cursor needs --force --sandbox enabled --trust. Direction: dispatch (or its config/docs per agent spec) should carry the sandbox flags each vendor CLI needs for unattended operation, and possibly a preflight that detects a too-restrictive sandbox and says so instead of producing strange downstream errors.
